title: The Collector
text: A polite gentleman in a carriage with no horses has drawn up by the road. Through its window you glimpse jars, and in the jars things that move. He collects curiosities, he says, and he would pay well for the story of how one of you got their worst scar.

outcomes.text: He pays in old gold and writes every word down.

options.label: The best liar tells a better one.

outcomes.text: He pays double, and knows, and does not mind.
He tips his hat and rolls on. As he goes you see him write something in a small book, and the scarred one cannot stop wondering what.
